human.problem: Satan appears in this passage with no word on who he is. He was first seen in the previous passage of the story group (Job 1:6), so it's unclear whether the "New people" rule applies again here.
human.question: Does the "New people" rule ("The first time someone shows up, he says simply who they are") apply per passage, or only the first time someone shows up in a story group? If it applies per passage, how should Satan be simply introduced in Job without going beyond what the text says?
